title: syngonanthus minutulus
intro: Syngonanthus minutulus, commonly known as "minúscula" or "small Syngonanthus", is a plant species in the family Aluminaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Syngonanthus minutulus include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
